description.Name: Heat/Tactile FUS stimulus driven fMRI data with Anatomic T1w Images

latestSnapshot.readme:
To investigate whether low-intensity FUS can suppress nociceptive heat stimulation-induced responses in thalamic nuclei during hand stimulation, and to determine how this suppression influences the information processing flow within nociception networks. These data sets were targeted VPL nuclei of Thalamus and Insula. We also demonstrated whether low-intensity FUS can suppress nociceptive heat stimulation-induced responses in thalamic nuclei during hand stimulation, and to determine how this suppression influences the information processing flow within nociception networks. These data sets were used for following publications. The electro-physiology data used for the work published in the following work are also available with the link below.

https://openneuro.org/datasets/ds008610/versions/1.0.0
